meta_title: Notts Heating & Plumbing | Gas Engineer Nottingham
meta_description: Notts Heating & Plumbing offer expert gas engineering, boiler installs, and plumbing across Nottingham. Gas Safe registered. Call today for a free quote.
hero_eyebrow: Gas Safe Registered — Boilers, Heating & Plumbing
hero_subhead: Boiler broken or heating failing? Get a fast, honest fix from a Gas Safe engineer you can trust.
services_heading: Complete Heating & Plumbing Services Across Nottingham
services_subhead: From emergency boiler repairs to full central heating installations, we cover every aspect of gas and plumbing work in Nottingham and the surrounding areas.

services.title: Boiler Repairs
services.desc: Fast diagnosis and repair of all boiler makes and models, getting your heating back up and running as quickly as possible. We carry a wide range of spare parts to fix most faults in a single visit.

services.title: Boiler Installations
services.desc: Supply and fit of energy-efficient new boilers from leading brands, tailored to your home's size and hot water demands. All installations are fully Gas Safe certified and come with a manufacturer warranty.

services.title: Central Heating Installation
services.desc: Complete new central heating systems designed and fitted to heat your home efficiently and reliably. We handle everything from pipework and radiators to programmer and thermostat setup.

services.title: Gas Safety Certificates
services.desc: Landlord gas safety inspections and CP12 certificates issued by a fully registered Gas Safe engineer. Protect your tenants and stay legally compliant with a thorough annual check.

services.title: Boiler Servicing
services.desc: Annual boiler services that keep your system running safely, efficiently, and within warranty conditions. Regular servicing can significantly reduce the risk of costly breakdowns during winter.

services.title: General Plumbing
services.desc: From leaking taps and burst pipes to bathroom installations and outdoor tap fitting, we handle all domestic plumbing work. No job is too small — reliable, tidy, and fairly priced every time.

about_pullquote: Every job gets the same care, whether it's a washer or a full system.
about_para_1: Notts Heating & Plumbing is a Nottingham-based gas and plumbing business operating from NG7, serving homeowners, landlords, and tenants across the city. Fully Gas Safe registered, we bring professional-grade expertise to every job, from a quick boiler service to a complete central heating installation.
about_para_2: We've built our reputation on straight-talking advice, transparent pricing, and work that's done right the first time. Our customers come back to us year after year — and recommend us to their neighbours — because we treat every home with the same care and respect we'd want in our own.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Boiler packed in on a cold morning and Notts Heating & Plumbing came out the same day. Diagnosed the fault quickly, had the part on the van, and had us back up and running within a couple of hours. Brilliant service and very reasonable price.
reviews.author: Karen T.

reviews.text: Had a new boiler fitted last month and couldn't be happier. The whole job was done neatly in one day, everything was explained clearly, and the price quoted was the price we paid. No nasty surprises. Would highly recommend.
reviews.author: David S.

reviews.text: Really trustworthy and professional. Came to service our boiler and also spotted a small issue we weren't aware of, sorted it on the spot at no extra charge. It's rare to find a tradesperson this honest. We'll definitely be using them again.
reviews.author: Michelle R.
